description: Story 1.2 - Full Post ID Visibility in Admin Panel + Story 1.3 - Multi-Media Indicators in Mobile Feed: (A) Admin: Show full Post ID with copy-to-clipboard button in Posts.tsx, Moderation.tsx, and Featured.tsx. Currently Posts.tsx has no ID column, Moderation.tsx shows #{report._id.slice(-6)}, Featured.tsx shows no post ID. (B) Mobile: Add multi-media count badge overlay on PostCard.tsx when post.media.length > 1, showing a layers icon and count number.
steps: Step 1 (Admin Posts.tsx): Add a 'Post ID' column to the table in admin/src/pages/Posts.tsx. Add it after the '#' column. Show the full post._id string. Add a copy button (use clipboard icon from lucide-react, e.g. 'Copy' or 'Clipboard'). On click, use navigator.clipboard.writeText(post._id) and show a brief 'Copied!' tooltip or change the icon momentarily. Import 'Copy, Check' from lucide-react. Use local state to track which ID was just copied.

Step 2 (Admin Moderation.tsx): Change the Report ID cell from #{report._id.slice(-6)} to show the full report._id. Add a small copy button next to it. Same pattern: navigator.clipboard.writeText(report._id), brief visual feedback. Import Copy and Check from lucide-react.

Step 3 (Admin Featured.tsx): Add the post ID display in the featured post cards. In the info section of each featured item, below the @username line, add a line showing 'Post ID: {item.postId._id}' in a small monospace font with a copy button. Same clipboard copy pattern.

Step 4 (Mobile PostCard.tsx): Add a multi-media indicator badge. When post.media && post.media.length > 1, render an absolute-positioned badge in the top-right corner of the imageWrapper View. The badge should show a layers/copy icon (use Feather 'layers' icon) and the count number (post.media.length). Style: small rounded pill, semi-transparent dark background (rgba(0,0,0,0.7)), white text, positioned top: 8, right: 8. Add styles for mediaBadge, mediaBadgeText. This must NOT affect existing touch handling or performance.

Step 5 (Mobile ExploreScreen.tsx): Add the same multi-media indicator badge to explore grid items. In the renderItem function, after the existing badge overlays, add a similar badge in the top-right showing media count when item.media?.length > 1. Use Feather 'layers' icon and count. Position: absolute, top: 4, right: 4.
acceptance_criteria: Admin Posts page shows full Post ID for each post with a working copy-to-clipboard button
Admin Moderation page shows full Report ID (not truncated) with copy button
Admin Featured page shows post ID with copy button for each featured post
Copy button provides visual feedback (icon change or tooltip) when clicked
Mobile PostCard shows media count badge (layers icon + number) when post has more than 1 media item
Mobile Explore grid items show media count badge when post has more than 1 media item
Media badge does not appear for posts with 0 or 1 media items
No performance impact - badge is a simple static overlay, no additional API calls or re-renders
verification: Run: node --check admin/src/pages/Posts.tsx (will fail for TSX - use grep to verify no obvious syntax errors)
Grep for 'navigator.clipboard' in Posts.tsx, Moderation.tsx, Featured.tsx to confirm copy functionality
Grep for 'media.length > 1' or 'media?.length > 1' in PostCard.tsx and ExploreScreen.tsx to confirm badge logic
Grep for 'layers' in PostCard.tsx and ExploreScreen.tsx to confirm icon usage
